Reads

What I’m reading and what I’ve finished, with a note on each. What’s on the nightstand this month is also on the now page.

Reading now

  • Trust reading

    Hernan Diaz, 2022

    An investigation into wealth, power, and who gets to write the official version of reality—told across four competing manuscripts that constantly pull the rug out from under the reader.

    Fiction · Capital & Narrative

Finished

  • A Thousand Splendid Suns finished

    Khaled Hosseini, 2007

    A devastating, deeply human portrait of endurance, unlikely friendship, and quiet defiance across generations in Kabul.

    Historical Fiction

  • Jonathan Livingston Seagull finished

    Richard Bach, 1970

    A short fable about a gull who cares more about learning to fly well than about fitting in with the flock.

    Fiction · Fable

  • L'Étranger (The Stranger) finished

    Albert Camus, 1942

    Deceptively simple sentences, where the Algerian sun and quiet existential indifference do all the heavy lifting.

    Philosophy · Absurdism

  • Le Petit Prince finished

    Antoine de Saint-Exupéry, 1943

    Still sharper about adult absurdity and bureaucracy than most books ten times its length.

    Classic · Fable
